summary: Full regression + new feature verification after Dashboard/NewChecklist/RepairsNeeded/QRScanner/AuthProvider extraction and new self-hosted Field Maps feature. All flows pass. Backend /api/fieldplan serves 1.80MB HTML with '#change-banner{display:none !important}' injected; POST /api/fieldplan/refresh returns success. Login (4444), Logout, and re-login work. All 4 dashboard sections render, all 8 estate tabs present, iframe loads self-hosted map with change-banner hidden, nav hidden, #mp visible; clicking euston/blakeney switches #mp-estate value without reload. Header Map button opens {BACKEND}/api/fieldplan?view=map in new tab. Workplan grid loads, RepairsNeeded loads, NewChecklist renders make/machine selection. No red console exceptions on tested pages (only 1 background 422 network error, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is still ~6,442 lines even after extraction — recommend continuing modularization (split routes/sections into pages/) to stay under 700 lines/file guideline.
One background HTTP 422 observed in console (non-blocking, no source identified). Consider tracing which API returns 422 and either handling gracefully or fixing the payload.
